claims.claim_text: Short-term insomnia is usually due to stress or a distressing event.
claims.evidence_span: Short-term insomnia is usually due to stress or a distressing event.

claims.claim_text: Long-term insomnia is usually due to stress, life events or habits that disrupt sleep.
claims.evidence_span: Long-term insomnia is usually due to stress, life events or habits that disrupt sleep.

claims.claim_text: About half the people with chronic insomnia also have at least one other mental health disorder, like anxiety or depression.
claims.evidence_span: About half the people with chronic insomnia also have at least one other mental health disorder, like anxiety or depression.

claims.claim_text: Temporary illnesses and chronic conditions can lead to insomnia.
claims.evidence_span: Temporary illnesses (like COVID-19 or injuries) and chronic conditions (like chronic pain or Parkinson’s disease) can lead to insomnia.

claims.claim_text: Studies in persons with insomnia have found increased heart rates, elevations in the stress hormone cortisol or greater amounts of fast brain activity around sleep onset.
claims.evidence_span: Studies in persons with insomnia have found increased heart rates, elevations in the stress hormone cortisol or greater amounts of fast brain activity around sleep onset.

claims.claim_text: Precipitating factors are circumstances that trigger the first few nights of insomnia.
claims.evidence_span: Precipitating factors are circumstances that trigger the first few nights of insomnia.

claims.claim_text: Secondary insomnia is caused by or happens alongside other health conditions or as a side effect of prescribed medicines.
claims.evidence_span: Secondary insomnia is caused by or happens alongside other health conditions or as a side effect of prescribed medicines.

claims.claim_text: Older women are at a higher risk of insomnia.
claims.evidence_span: Older women are at a higher risk of insomnia.

claims.claim_text: From daily deadlines to major life changes, stress is one of the leading causes of insomnia.
claims.evidence_span: From daily deadlines to major life changes, stress is one of the leading causes of insomnia.

claims.claim_text: Even small disruptions, like an unfamiliar bed or a travel schedule, can trigger short-term insomnia.
claims.evidence_span: Even small disruptions, like an unfamiliar bed or a travel schedule, can trigger short‑term insomnia.
